import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
import "experimental"
import "math"

getOrDefault = (f, d) => if exists f then f else d

// Aggregate cost per user
data_request = from(bucket: "default_agg_kpi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>  r._field == "cost" and r.user_hash != "undefined")
  |> group(columns: ["user_hash"])
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> group()

// Sort users by total cost in descending order and assign row IDs
sorted_users = data_request
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with rowId: 1}))
  |> cumulativeSum(columns: ["rowId"])

// Compute min and max rowId values
rowId_max = sorted_users |> max(column: "rowId") |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
rowId_min = sorted_users |> min(column: "rowId") |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

// Compute 10% percentile boundaries using min and max rowId
rowId_range = float(v: rowId_max.rowId - rowId_min.rowId)  

p_90 = int(v: math.ceil(x: float(v: rowId_min.rowId) + (rowId_range * 0.9)))
p_80 = int(v: math.ceil(x: float(v: rowId_min.rowId) + (rowId_range * 0.8)))
p_70 = int(v: math.ceil(x: float(v: rowId_min.rowId) + (rowId_range * 0.7)))
p_60 = int(v: math.ceil(x: float(v: rowId_min.rowId) + (rowId_range * 0.6)))
p_50 = int(v: math.ceil(x: float(v: rowId_min.rowId) + (rowId_range * 0.5)))
p_40 = int(v: math.ceil(x: float(v: rowId_min.rowId) + (rowId_range * 0.4)))
p_30 = int(v: math.ceil(x: float(v: rowId_min.rowId) + (rowId_range * 0.3)))
p_20 = int(v: math.ceil(x: float(v: rowId_min.rowId) + (rowId_range * 0.2)))
p_10 = int(v: math.ceil(x: float(v: rowId_min.rowId) + (rowId_range * 0.1)))
p_01 = int(v: math.ceil(x: float(v: rowId_min.rowId) + (rowId_range * 0.01)))

// Map percentiles to each user based on request count thresholds
determinePercentiles = (sorted_users, topUsers) => 
  if topUsers == "No" then
  sorted_users
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      cost: r._value,
      rowId: r.rowId,
      percentile_user: if r.rowId >= p_90 then "0-10%"
                  else if r.rowId >= p_80 then "11-20%"
                  else if r.rowId >= p_70 then "21-30%"
                  else if r.rowId >= p_60 then "31-40%"
                  else if r.rowId >= p_50 then "41-50%"
                  else if r.rowId >= p_40 then "51-60%"
                  else if r.rowId >= p_30 then "61-70%"
                  else if r.rowId >= p_20 then "71-80%"
                  else if r.rowId >= p_10 then "81-90%"
                  else "Top 10%"
  }))
  else
    sorted_users
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      cost: r._value,
      rowId: r.rowId,
      percentile_user: if r.rowId >= p_90 then "0-10%"
                  else if r.rowId >= p_80 then "11-20%"
                  else if r.rowId >= p_70 then "21-30%"
                  else if r.rowId >= p_60 then "31-40%"
                  else if r.rowId >= p_50 then "41-50%"
                  else if r.rowId >= p_40 then "51-60%"
                  else if r.rowId >= p_30 then "61-70%"
                  else if r.rowId >= p_20 then "71-80%"
                  else if r.rowId >= p_10 then "81-90%"
                  else if r.rowId >= p_01 then "91-99%"
                  else "Top 1%"
  }))
// Define the bucket and call the function
topUsers = "${Show_Top1_percent}" // Replace with your actual bucket variable
percentiles = determinePercentiles(sorted_users: sorted_users, topUsers: topUsers)
// Aggregate total cost per percentile
percentile_data = percentiles
  |> group(columns: ["percentile_user"])
  |> sum(column: "cost")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with join_key: "cross_join"})) // Dummy key for joining
  |> group()

// Compute total cost across all users
total_cost_data = percentiles
  |> sum(column: "cost")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({total_cost: r.cost, join_key: "cross_join"})) // Dummy key for joining

// Join total and percentile cost data
cross_joined_data = join(
  tables: {percentile: percentile_data, total: total_cost_data},
  on: ["join_key"]
)
|> map(fn: (r) => ({
      percent_of_cost: r.cost / r.total_cost * 100.0,
      percentile_user: r.percentile_user,
      sort: if r.percentile_user == "0-10%" then 0
             else if r.percentile_user == "11-20%" then 1
             else if r.percentile_user == "21-30%" then 2
             else if r.percentile_user == "31-40%" then 3
             else if r.percentile_user == "41-50%" then 4
             else if r.percentile_user == "51-60%" then 5
             else if r.percentile_user == "61-70%" then 6
             else if r.percentile_user == "71-80%" then 7
             else if r.percentile_user == "81-90%" then 8
             else if r.percentile_user == "91-99%" then 9
             else if r.percentile_user == "91-99%" then 10
             else 11
  }))

// Return sorted output
cross_joined_data
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["sort"], desc: true)

      percentile_user: if r.rowId >= p_90 then "0-10%"
                  else if r.rowId >= p_80 then "11-20%"
                  else if r.rowId >= p_70 then "21-30%"
                  else if r.rowId >= p_60 then "31-40%"
                  else if r.rowId >= p_50 then "41-50%"
                  else if r.rowId >= p_40 then "51-60%"
                  else if r.rowId >= p_30 then "61-70%"
                  else if r.rowId >= p_20 then "71-80%"
                  else if r.rowId >= p_10 then "81-90%"
                  else if r.rowId >= p_01 then "91-99%"
                  else "Top 1%"
  }))
// Define the bucket and call the function
topUsers = "${Show_Top1_percent}" // Replace with your actual bucket variable
percentiles = determinePercentiles(sorted_users: sorted_users, topUsers: topUsers)
// Aggregate total request_count per percentile
percentile_data = percentiles
  |> group(columns: ["percentile_user"])
  |> sum(column: "request_count")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with join_key: "cross_join"})) // Dummy key for joining
  |> group()

// Compute total request_count across all users
total_request_count_data = percentiles
  |> sum(column: "request_count")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({total_request_count: r.request_count, join_key: "cross_join"})) // Dummy key for joining

// Join total and percentile request_count data
cross_joined_data = join(
  tables: {percentile: percentile_data, total: total_request_count_data},
  on: ["join_key"]
)
|> map(fn: (r) => ({
  request_count:r.request_count,
      percent_of_request:float(v: r.request_count) / float(v: r.total_request_count)*100.0,  
      Percentile_user: r.percentile_user,
      sort: if r.percentile_user == "0-10%" then 0
             else if r.percentile_user == "11-20%" then 1
             else if r.percentile_user == "21-30%" then 2
             else if r.percentile_user == "31-40%" then 3
             else if r.percentile_user == "41-50%" then 4
             else if r.percentile_user == "51-60%" then 5
             else if r.percentile_user == "61-70%" then 6
             else if r.percentile_user == "71-80%" then 7
             else if r.percentile_user == "81-90%" then 8
             else if r.percentile_user == "91-99%" then 9
             else if r.percentile_user == "91-99%" then 10
             else 11
  }))

// Return sorted output
cross_joined_data
  |> group()
   |> rename(columns: {"percent_of_request": "Percent of request", "request_count": "Request count"})
  |> sort(columns: ["sort"], desc: true)
|> drop(columns:["sort"] )

    {language: "sl", full_name: "Slovenian"}

])

// Aggregate request counts per group
data_request = from(bucket: "default_agg_stats")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r._field == "prompt_tokens" or r._field == "completion_tokens" or r._field == "request_count" or r._field == "price" or r._field == "user_hash"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.language)
  |> schema.fieldsAsCols()
  |> group(columns: ["language","user_hash"])
  |> reduce(
      fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
        request_count: getOrDefault(f: r.request_count, d: 0) + accumulator.request_count,
        prompt_tokens: getOrDefault(f: r.prompt_tokens, d: 0) + accumulator.prompt_tokens,
        completion_tokens: getOrDefault(f: r.completion_tokens, d: 0) + accumulator.completion_tokens,
        price: getOrDefault(f: r.price, d: 0.0) + accumulator.price,
        user_count: accumulator.user_count + 1,
      }),
      identity: {request_count: 0, prompt_tokens: 0, completion_tokens: 0, price: 0.0, user_count: 0}
  )

        prompt_tokens: getOrDefault(f: r.prompt_tokens, d: 0) + accumulator.prompt_tokens,

  )

    on: ["language"]  // Corrected join condition
)

    language: getOrDefault(f: r.full_name, d: r.language), // Replace language code with full name
    request_count: r.request_count,
    prompt_tokens: r.prompt_tokens,
    completion_tokens: r.completion_tokens,
    price: r.price,
    cost_per_request: if r.request_count > 0 then float(v: r.price) / float(v: r.request_count) * 1000.0 else 0.0 , // Safe division
    prompt_per_request: if r.request_count > 0 then float(v: r.prompt_tokens) / float(v: r.request_count) else 0.0, // Safe division
    user_count: r.user_count
}))

// Sort and display results
data_with_lang_names
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["request_count"], desc: true)
